variant_title_en: Multiplication and Division of Whole Numbers
title_en: Multiplication and Division of Whole Numbers
story_theme_en: A food packaging factory produces 18 boxes per minute. It works for 45 minutes. How many boxes does it produce in total? Then it puts the boxes into delivery trucks with 135 boxes per truck. How many full trucks will there be?
helper_tip: Multiply first, then divide. Watch out for carrying when multiplying.
hint_th: คูณก่อนหาร ระวังการทดตอนคูณ

visual_blocks.title: Story
visual_blocks.content: A food packaging factory produces 18 boxes per minute. It works for 45 minutes. How many boxes does it produce in total? Then it puts the boxes into delivery trucks with 135 boxes per truck. How many full trucks will there be?

data.content_en: A food packaging factory produces 18 boxes per minute. It works for 45 minutes. How many boxes does it produce in total? Then it puts the boxes into delivery trucks with 135 boxes per truck. How many full trucks will there be?

visual_blocks.title: Think
visual_blocks.content: Step 1: Find total boxes → 18 x 45 = total boxes | Step 2: Divide into trucks → total / 135 = number of trucks

data.content_en: Step 1: Find total boxes → 18 x 45 = total boxes | Step 2: Divide into trucks → total / 135 = number of trucks

visual_blocks.title: Try It
visual_blocks.question: Students arrange flowers in vases. 24 flowers per vase, 15 vases. How many flowers in total? If they put them in big vases with 60 flowers each, how many big vases can they fill?

data.question: Students arrange flowers in vases. 24 flowers per vase, 15 vases. How many flowers in total? If they put them in big vases with 60 flowers each, how many big vases can they fill?

worked_examples.question_en: A cake shop has 12 boxes with 45 cakes per box. How many cakes in total?

common_mistakes: Multiplying incorrectly, especially with two-digit numbers
Forgetting to carry when the product exceeds 9
hints: Use long multiplication or short multiplication.
